peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (RCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Around peers (56.9): 3.3 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 219 of 393 similar developments with a figure (the same as 9). Initial resale-wave effect: 1 of the 2 resales in Oct 2024–Sep 2026 came in the first 12 months of the resale wave (Oct 2024–Feb 2025); the sustained rate is shown separately. The wave start is based on the analytical proxy: the month recorded resales first reach 2% of homes; not an official MOP date. Context, not scored: resales in 8.3% of months (24 months).

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (RCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: 2.1 resales per 100 homes a year over 19 months (Mar 2025–Sep 2026): higher than 98 of 379 similar developments. First resale wave from Mar 2024 (analytical proxy: the month recorded resales first reach 2% of homes; not an official MOP date). Observed 24-month activity: 3.3.

wave.basisLabel: analytical proxy: the month recorded resales first reach 2% of homes; not an official MOP date

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Novena MRT about 470 m, Toa Payoh MRT about 840 m; closer than 367 of 662 similar developments (the same as 15). Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 2 within 1 km and 9 within 2 km; nearest ST. Joseph's Institution Junior about 800 m; more than 292 of 662 similar developments (the same as 254). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 10 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 240 m), more than 426 of 662 similar developments (the same as 86); nearest hawker centre Whampoa Drive Makan Place/Whampoa Market about 900 m; nearest park Toa Payoh Town Park about 570 m. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 5 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (Sanctuary@Newton, 16 new sales, about 1,110 m; 32 Gilstead, 3 new sales, about 1,140 m; The Orie, 25 new sales, about 1,700 m; Piccadilly Grand, 1 new sales, about 1,720 m; The Arcady at Boon Keng, 32 new sales, about 1,990 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 303 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 77 new sales and 808 resales (885 purchases); new sales were 8.7% of these purchases. Subsales (54) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Not a quiet area. 808 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 347 of 662 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 808 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 865 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−6.6%). Planning-area private resales −6.3%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
